description: A little glass capsule on the edge of your Windows screen: Claude Code and Codex usage, approvals, your calendar and your ideas.
notes: Start Capsule from the Start menu: Scoop Apps > Capsule.
Update with 'scoop update capsule'. Your settings in %USERPROFILE%\.capsule are kept.
Before 'scoop uninstall capsule', choose Disconnect from Claude Code (and from Codex / Work) in Capsule's menu if you connected them.
